main_body: wooden tea table with teapot and cups on top
top_band: orange border and tan/beige tabletop from row 5 to row 9
evidence: Reading down a middle column: rows 5-9 form a 5px foreshortened tabletop (row 5 orange back rim, rows 6-8 tan/beige surface with small cup details, row 9 red-orange front edge). Below it, row 10 is a darker red front apron, row 11 is an inset brown drawer band with yellow pulls, row 12 is a dark eave/underside shadow, and rows 13-15 show the legs.

style.evidence: The piece uses rich warm wood and lacquer ramps (6+ steps across tan, orange, red-brown, and dark brown), selective dark-brown material outlines rather than black, and detailed surface variation (teapot, cups, drawer pulls, shaded edges) matching the Beodeul reference props.
